_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Creating the share link in Metodic…

description: Create a shareable link to a session so someone else can see it WITHOUT a Metodic account: a client or sponsor who has to approve the programme, a co-facilitator, or the participants. Optionally writes a client-facing brief first (audience 'client') and shares that alongside the plan. Returns the link. Reuses an existing link for the same session instead of making a second one. Free unless a brief is generated (~0.5 credit).

audience.description: Who the link is for. 'client' is the default and the most common: a sponsor who must approve it.

document.description: Which saved document opens on the shared page: 'latest' (default for a client — the most recent document in the session, e.g. a brief you just wrote), 'none' for the plan only, or a document id.

expires_in_days.description: Optional: let the link expire after this many days.

with_brief.description: Also write a short client-facing brief for the session (costs ~0.5 credit). Default false.

name: share_session
title: Share a session
